segments.text: Most of what matters in your life comes from a tiny handful of moments. It's called tails driving everything.
A rare few events drive the huge majority of results. In investing, in business, in your own choices.
Most startups die. A rare few pay for all the losers combined. Most of your best days won't feel special when they happen.
So you can be wrong half the time and still win, as long as the few times you're right, you're really right.
A few things carry everything. Full verdict on the channel.
